title: Claude's New AI Costs 10 Cents Per Million
description:
Claude Haiku 5.5: $0.10 in / $0.50 out per million tokens for prompts up to 100k (Haiku 4.5 is $1 / $5). Over 100k tokens: $0.50 / $2.50. Source: platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing
